t: Refuge taken in the one attribute nothing else has
a: أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّتِكَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، الَّذِي لاَ يَمُوتُ وَالْجِنُّ وَالإِنْسُ يَمُوتُونَ
p: Aʿūdhu bi-ʿizzatika-lladhī lā ilāha illā ant, alladhī lā yamūtu wa-l-jinnu wa-l-insu yamūtūn
m: I seek refuge in Your might, You beside whom there is no god, who does not die, while jinn and men die.
